docTitle: Mamta Singh Sengar — Teamware QE Software Engineer
name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==QE SOFTWARE ENGINEER==  ·  TEST AUTOMATION FRAMEWORKS & PRODUCT QUALITY

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: Quality engineer with **4.8 years of experience**, including **2 years developing and maintaining test automation frameworks**. Built and maintained Selenium BDD (Cucumber) and Playwright frameworks, integrated them into CI/CD, and ensured **product quality** across web/mobile and enterprise applications.

sections.heading: CORE SKILLS
rows: Jira · Local Test Case Generator (Jira workflow)

roles.title: Software Test Engineer / Senior QA
bullets: ==Developed and maintained test automation frameworks== using Selenium BDD (Cucumber) and Playwright.
==Ensured product quality== — automated 200 test cases, reducing manual regression effort by 30%.
Maintained framework stability across CI/CD — integrated into Jenkins / GitHub Actions, cutting release verification time from 3 days → 1 day.
Built API automation with Rest Assured and validated backend flows with SQL.

roles.title: Testing Engineer
bullets: Executed functional, integration, system, regression, and UAT cycles for payment, gaming, and retail domains.
Tracked defects in Jira and improved defect resolution SLA from 72 hrs → 48 hrs.
Validated payment transactions and MPOS flows; analysed middleware logs to reduce payment failures by 20%.

roles.title: Career Break & Upskilling
bullets: Playwright: built automated web test suites; converted 100 manual scenarios to automated checks.
CI/CD: integrated test execution into Jenkins and GitHub Actions for PR gating and nightly regression.
Local Test Case Generator (Jira): designed a workflow to auto-generate structured test cases from Jira tickets, reducing test design time by 50%.
AI Prompting for QA: created prompts/workflows to generate test ideas and edge cases, accelerating test design by 40%.
